day_line: A candle flame on a Rooster day. Warm and precise: good for careful work and kind words, easy to get fussy.

lines.Yang Wood: Say the quiet part kindly today. One clear line in the meeting beats a long email later.
lines.Yin Wood: Thursday has a spark for you. Try the new hawker stall; tell the group chat if it's good.
lines.Yang Fire: Someone wants the spotlight today. Let them shine first; your turn comes after lunch.
lines.Yin Fire: Your kind of people are near today. Ask a friend to sit in on the plan; it'll go faster.
lines.Yang Earth: An older voice has good advice today. Call them on the way home and really listen.
lines.Yin Earth: You read the room well today. Trust the feeling, but say it gently.
lines.Yang Metal: Your effort gets a proper nod today. Keep your promise on time; it seals the deal.
lines.Yin Metal: Small demands stack up today. Pick the top three; the rest can wait till Friday.
lines.Yang Water: Patient money moves today. Clear one bill early and feel lighter.
lines.Yin Water: A small door opens today. Reply quickly, then sleep on the details.
